notes: GoldStar (LG) window unit, top-down chassis, cool only. Part numbers are from the GWHD6500R column; where the two models differ (compressor, overload, capacitor, capillary, suction tube), the RY6 numbers are noted.

gaps: The parts list gives no ratings for the compressor or capacitor.
These shared drawings also show a sync motor, 4-way valve, medium fan relay and air purifier/ion outputs that this cool-only, 2-speed model's parts list and spec table do not include.
None of the chip markings is from a photo of this exact board.
method: Rated 6,500 BTU/h, 115 V 60 Hz, 670 W and 6.1 A.
Source: LG-format Room Air Conditioner Service Manual for GWHD6500R and GWHD6500RY6 (P/No. 3828A20529B, printed October 2005), Internet Archive copy (manualzilla mirror), read as text.
The specifications (PDF p. 3), service parts list (PDF p. 30) and electronic control schematic (PDF p. 27) were also rendered and read as images.
The control schematic (PDF p. 27) and circuit diagram (PDF p. 26) are shared platform drawings.

Board chip markings come from the schematic and were kept only where this model's main PWB component-location drawing (PDF p. 28, PWB ass'y 6871A20188, matching parts-list 6871A20188L) or its troubleshooting flow (PDF p.
20-22) names the same reference (IC01D, IC02D, D02D-D05D, IC01M, IC01G, OSC01B, Micom, RY-COMP, RY-Hi/RY-Lo, fuse, transformer).
The troubleshooting flow (PDF p. 20) gives the transformer and regulator voltages; the main PWB drawing also marks the fuse 250V T2A.
Ext/obs and qty on extra parts are editorial (one part number listed).

comps.spec: Compressor set, LG part 2520UCEA004 (loc. 554160; GWHD6500RY6 uses 2520AA1C71A); spec table: R-22 charge 380 g (13.4 oz) for GWHD6500R, overload protector for compressor, capillary tube refrigerant control
Compressor overload protector (O.L.P), LG part 6750U-L058A (loc. 567502; GWHD6500RY6 uses 6750A90016A)
Capacitor, LG part 0CZZA20001W (loc. W0CZZ; GWHD6500RY6 uses 6120AR2359V); the schematic shows one capacitor with FAN, C and HERM terminals
Motor assembly, single, LG part 4681A10002U (loc. 346811); spec table: fan motor 6 poles, 28 W, internal protector for fan motor
Turbo fan 5900A10005A (loc. 359012, inside fan) and fan propeller 5900A20017A (loc. 559010; spec table: outside propeller fan with slinger ring)

Thermistor assembly, LG part 6323A20003D (loc. 263230); spec table gives thermistor temperature control; the circuit diagram lists one thermistor, and the control schematic puts the room thermistor (ROOM-TH) on connector CN-TH1
PWB (PCB) assembly, main, LG part 6871A20188L (loc. 268714); a separate PWB (PCB) assembly, display, part 6871A20193B (loc. 268712), is also listed
Capillary tube assembly 5211A30793C (loc. 552111; RY6 uses 5211A30793D), evaporator assembly 5421A20016G, condenser assembly 5403A20009E, discharge tube 5210A21100A, suction tube 5211A10062C

Microcontroller marked MICOM TMP87CH47U on the control schematic, with an RT8.00MG resonator (OSC01B); this model's troubleshooting flow checks Micom pins 14 (reset) and 18 for 5 V, matching that drawing's pinout, and OSC01B appears on the main PWB drawing

Two ULN2004A arrays on the control schematic: IC01M switches the 12 V relay coils (troubleshooting checks its pins when the compressor or fan will not run) and IC01G drives the display lines (troubleshooting: abnormal display)
7812 (IC01D) and 7805 (IC02D) regulators after a 1N4004 bridge (D02D-D05D); troubleshooting flow checks 12 V DC at IC01D and 5 V DC at IC02D

Compressor relay RY-COMP marked G4A-1A-E-LG on the control schematic and shown on the main PWB drawing; fan relays RY-LO and RY-HI (the troubleshooting flow names RY-Hi or RY-Lo; spec table: 2-speed fan switch)
Fuse marked 250V/T2A on the electronic control schematic
Power transformer (POWER TRANS on the main PWB drawing); troubleshooting flow checks for AC 115 V, then about AC 14 V from the transformer
